name: Silhouette-Based Bounding Box Estimation
definition: Computes a 3D bounding box for the scene by backprojecting silhouette masks from multiple training views to find the tightest volume containing all visible geometry.
summary: Silhouette-Based Bounding Box Estimation computes a 3D volume enclosing an object by intersecting back-projected foreground regions from multiple binary masks, differing from other methods by relying solely on 2D image masks.
